name: boc_policy_rate
note: Bank of Canada fixed announcement dates for the policy interest rate, at the Bank's own local time. Read by desks/mt5/mt5desk/local_clock.calendar_mask: a family given calendar='boc_policy_rate' fires ONLY on these dates. 2025: the Bank's 2025 schedule release (09:45 ET). 2026: the Bank's key-interest-rate page (Jan-Sep) and its 2027 schedule release / announcement pages for the time (09:45 ET); 28 Oct and 9 Dec are scheduled, not yet held on 2026-09-30. 2024 and earlier are NOT listed: the 2024 schedule release states 10:00 ET and a procedure change effective 2024 whose time was not verified, so those dates wait for a verified time rather than being guessed. Append new years from the Bank's annual schedule release.
